arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Pincus stated Kentucky applies a more demanding rule for arbitration powers of attorney.
Justice Sotomayor questioned if the Wellner case aligns with neutral contract interpretation.
Justice Alito noted the context involves elderly care rather than simple billing disputes.
Mr. Salyer stated Kentucky is a common law state in power of attorney law.
